verdict.rationale: Kintsugi documents its own exemption records with validity dates, certificate file uploads attached to an exemption, and tax estimates that reflect the customer's exemptions. That covers storage and automatic application at calculation time. Nothing in the evidence shows how certificates are collected from customers or how they are validated, and validity dates alone are not proven expiry tracking. Missing for 10: customer-facing certificate collection workflow, certificate validation, expiry tracking/renewal alerts, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, exemption and resale certificates are managed end to end — collected from customers, validated, stored with expiry tracking, and applied automatically at calculation time
